items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Basie's not here. He's in the studio and Billy Eckstine is making a recording.

ctx.x: Basie was in New York City. When I got with

Basie I talked with him at the barbershop in the daytime, which was very difficult to get a phone call through, because we was still at war with Japan. But I finally got Basie. Then Milt Ebbins got on the phone and he says, "Basie's not here. He's in the studio and Billy Eckstine is making a recording." I said, "Well, make 'Cottage for Sale' for me in the key of E flat." So he made it. I said, "Do that for the old soldier boy."
